Radiology Report
Date: 08/16/2026
Patient: Lakisha Mills, 85 y/o F

Exam: MRI cervical spine

Findings: MRI cervical spine 08/16/2026: C6-C7 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root. No evidence of fracture or marrow edema. Vertebral alignment preserved. No significant central canal stenosis noted. Adjacent discs show mild degenerative changes without significant protrusion.

Impression: C6-C7 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root. No acute osseous abnormality.

Pain Management Consultation
Date: 09/23/2026
Patient: Lakisha Mills, 85 y/o F

CC: Neck pain x11 wks w/ radiation to R UE.

HPI: Pt c/o neck pain ongoing for 11 weeks, radiating to right upper extremity. No hx of prior spine surgery. Denies rash or shingles.

Exam: Limited neck ROM, tenderness over cervical paraspinals. Neuro exam shows decreased sensation in R UE dermatomes, mild weakness in R hand grip.

Assessment: Cervical radiculopathy likely given clinical presentation.

Plan: Recommend cervical MRI to evaluate nerve root involvement. Initiate conservative measures including NSAIDs and physical therapy. Will consider interventional options pending imaging and response.

Follow-up in 4 weeks or sooner if symptoms worsen.
